title: 第3章 剑啸破空第4章 记名弟子
content_zh:
黑色飞舟舱腹狭窄。
“进去！”
劫修一声低喝，粗糙的大手一推。
七个孩子手腕被粗绳穿系在一起，踉跄着跌进一处舱室。
“砰！”
舱门猛地合上，舱室内顿时漆黑一片，伸手不见五指。
楚无忌被人带倒，肩头狠狠撞在舱壁上，痛得半边身子发麻。他吸了口凉气，却不敢吭声。
许青禾的那声哭叫，还在他耳边回荡。
黑暗中，有人急促喘息。
有人牙关打颤，咯咯作响。
还有人想哭，却硬把哭声憋成了低低的呜咽。
半晌，角落里传来一个带着哭腔的低声：
“我……我想回家……”
无人回应。
又过了一会儿，另一个孩子哆嗦着问：“他们……会把我们带去哪？”
仍旧无人回应。
楚无忌闭上眼，背靠舱壁，一言不发，以节省体力。
他知道靠着这几个孩子，根本不可能从众多劫修手中逃生，只能强行把一切惊惧都压进心底，在心里徒劳地祈求，希望有如前世小说中侠客般的修士，能替天行道，从天而降，救他们脱困。
时间一天天过去。
舱室里除了黑暗，还是黑暗。

只有每天固定一次，劫修打开舱门，把一袋干粮、一皮囊水往里一丢的时候，才会有些许光亮。
一天，两天，三天......
挣扎、低头、求饶、讨生、苟活……
所有凡人可能想到的每一条活路，在劫修的强大武力面前，都没有任何意义。
......
变数，出现在第七天。
那一日，飞舟忽然一震，舱内几个孩子猝不及防，纷纷摔倒在地，撞得眼冒金星。
陆景承惊恐地问：“怎、怎么了？”
楚无忌勉强撑住舱壁，声音发颤：“别动……听！”
外头骤然响起一道破空的尖啸。
嗤！
content_en:
The belly of the black flying boat is narrow.
"Get in!"
Jie Xiu shouted low and pushed with his big rough hand.
The seven children's wrists were tied together with thick ropes, and they staggered into a cabin.
"Bang!"
The cabin door slammed shut, and the cabin suddenly became dark, making it impossible to see.
Chu Wuji was brought down, his shoulder hit the bulkhead hard, half of his body was numb with pain. He took a breath, but didn't dare to say anything.
Xu Qinghe's cry was still echoing in his ears.
In the darkness, someone was breathing rapidly.
Someone's teeth chattered and rattled.
Others wanted to cry, but suppressed their cries into low sobs.
After a while, a crying voice came from the corner:
"I...I want to go home..."
No one responded.
After a while, another child asked tremblingly: "Where...will they take us?"
Still no response.
Chu Wuji closed his eyes and leaned against the bulkhead, saying nothing to save energy.
He knew that it was impossible for these children to escape from the hands of so many cultivators, so he could only suppress all the fear in his heart and pray in vain in his heart, hoping that the knight-like monks in the novels of his previous life would act on behalf of heaven and descend from the sky to save them.
Time passes day by day.
There was nothing but darkness in the cabin.
Only once a day, when Jie Xiu opens the cabin door and throws a bag of dry food and a skin of water inside, will there be a little light.
One day, two days, three days...
Struggling, bowing, begging for mercy, begging for life, surviving...
Every way a mortal might think of to survive is meaningless in the face of Jie Xiu's powerful force.
...
The change occurred on the seventh day.
That day, the flying boat suddenly shook. Several children in the cabin were caught off guard and fell to the ground one after another, making stars appear in their eyes.
Lu Jingcheng asked in horror: "What, what's wrong?"
Chu Wuji barely held on to the bulkhead, his voice trembling: "Don't move...listen!"
A loud scream suddenly sounded outside.
laugh!
